Claude Code's docs also warn mods run with your permissions and aren't sandboxed, so running `claude plugin validate` on a mod first is worth the 10 seconds.

Great overview and tips! This looks like a very useful feature. One concern I have is that it could lead to vendor lock-in since Anthropic is the only one of the frontier labs that has this feature. It’s a clever strategy that I’m sure they are aware of to get people to stick with Claude. And right now with the power and generous usage limits of Opus 5.5, Claude is my favorite ecosystem. But historically that has changed as new models get released, and I like the freedom to move between labs and subscriptions. I like skills because they are universal and reusable/portable across different ecosystems. It would be awesome to have an open mod standard like skills/MCP. I hope that OpenAI does follow suit with a feature like this. And even though the ChatGPT/Codex app has a different architecture than Claude Code, with the help of agents I’m sure it won’t hard to replicate most mods from Claude into it. But for now I feel weary of investing too heavily into Claude mods and becoming dependent on them.
